findings.summary: U1 pin TESTEN (__unnamed_76) missing pull-up resistor
findings.description: Pin TESTEN on U1 (VL813(A1)) is connected to net __unnamed_76 but has no pull-up resistor. This pin type typically requires an external pull-up to a power rail for correct operation.
findings.recommendation: Add a 4.7k-10k pull-up resistor from __unnamed_76 to the appropriate power rail.

fix_params.basis: Pin TESTEN is open-drain/input type requiring pull-up

report_context.impact: Pin may float or bus may not function without pull-up
